scope: 61 active principal portraits: atlas 01, 02, 03-spaced, 04-spaced, 05, 06-safe, 07 and the separate Garam/Haram source. Standalone Yeonwoo/Haein and recurring/acting portraits are audited by other owners.
boxConvention: x/y are the first included source pixel; width/height are counts; right/bottom are exclusive.

measurementMethod.method: Manual visual landmark measurement on enlarged nearest-neighbor source-pixel grids, then a second source overlay review of each proposed box. Original RGBA pixels were read without editing.
measurementMethod.verticalReference: Visible forehead/hairline to the anatomical chin; ears included in the horizontal extent. Hair, headgear, and neck below the chin do not determine the face-height anchor.
measurementMethod.occlusions: Where a beard hides the chin, use the anatomical jaw estimate and exclude beard tips below it. Where the head is shaved, the forehead reference is estimated without using the top of the scalp. These records are explicitly marked and carry wider uncertainty.
measurementMethod.boundingBoxCaveat: An axis-aligned landmark box may contain fringe, beard or neck corners because of the pose; it is an anchor rectangle, not a pixel-exact skin segmentation mask.
excludedMethods: No body-height fraction used for the new measurements
No skin-color threshold used to replace visual landmarks
No image generation, stretching, repainting or source/crop editing
measurementMethod.uncertainty: Manual source-pixel boundary estimates: ordinarily ±2 px, partially occluded or inferred boundaries ±3–4 px. The figures are not automatic landmark detections.

reference.note: Approved Seoa neutral source was opened and compared. Its fixed 143 px forehead-to-chin reference remains unchanged.

baseline.codeBaseline: PR8 main 98c2462f969b0b6648e16613e460853fc0db7655, with concurrent work explicitly excluded from this audit's changes.

heuristicAudit.activeMeasurementPath: scripts/measure-three-fullbody-art.py reads faceBounds directly from each layout entry via rect(*entry['faceBounds']); full-body portrait compilation copies those values.
heuristicAudit.conclusion: The current tracked measurement path does not calculate face height as 0.17 of body height. The origin of the old hardcoded coordinates is not established by that code, so a previous heuristic cannot be proved or excluded from numeric coincidence alone.

renderingImpact.existingFormula: uniformScale = CSS target face height / source faceBounds.height × existing age/faceScale; this audit changes only the source face anchor proposal.

hangyeolExample.explanation: Ten source pixels of headband/hair above the forehead and 21 pixels of neck below the chin cease to determine the face-height anchor. The unchanged sourceRect is 398/523/240/508.

preservation.changeProposal: Only entries[].newFaceBounds is proposed for coordinated metadata application. Old anchors and unchanged source/crop signatures are retained for comparison.
preservation.runtimeVisualReview: Pending after coordinated application; source landmark review alone does not prove layout, actor overlap, face balance at all viewport widths or all original body proportions.
